_about: Cloud 2026-11-03. Common mistake pairs for the language point of each lesson (the key point whose head.en contains `head`). Applied by apply-mistakes.mjs; the point's existing tip gives the why. One error per pair, the one Turkish and Persian speakers make most with that point.

ai-1.head: Recommending a tool
ai-1.wrong: If you will need links, try Perplexity.
ai-1.right: If you need links, try Perplexity.

ai-2.head: Describing a problem
ai-2.wrong: I can't to open the file.

ai-3.head: Rules at work
ai-3.wrong: You don't have to paste client names into the tool.
ai-3.right: You must not paste client names into the tool.

ai-4.head: Clear orders
ai-4.wrong: Write a summary for customers in less 100 words.
ai-4.right: Write a summary for customers, under 100 words.

ai-5.head: Staying with the text
ai-5.wrong: According to the document, it says the fee is 40 euros.
ai-5.right: According to the document, the fee is 40 euros.

ai-6.head: Saying what is wrong
ai-6.wrong: The answer don't say the date.
ai-6.right: The answer doesn't say the date.

ai-8.head: Asking for one change
ai-8.wrong: Same picture, no people, don't change other.
ai-8.right: Keep everything the same, but remove the people.

ai-9.head: Order of steps
ai-9.wrong: Before you will send the file, check the names.
ai-9.right: Before you send the file, check the names.

ai-10.head: Reporting a correction
ai-10.wrong: The draft is saying 30 June, but the sheet is saying 15 June.
ai-10.right: The draft says 30 June, but the sheet says 15 June.

ai-11.head: Plain versions
ai-11.wrong: Please do not hesitate to contact us should you require further assistance.
ai-11.right: If you have any questions, just reply to this email.

ai-12.head: Saying how sure
ai-12.wrong: This is 100% true because the AI said it.
ai-12.right: This seems to be true, but I still need to check the source.

ai-14.head: Talking about sources
ai-14.wrong: The report is published from a sugar company.
ai-14.right: The report is published by a sugar company.

ai-15.head: Small words that matter
ai-15.wrong: The price is 300 euros, VAT is excluding.
ai-15.right: The price is 300 euros, excluding VAT.

ai-16.head: Reporting a talk
ai-16.wrong: She said us the office is moving.
ai-16.right: She told us the office is moving.

int-1.head: present perfect or past simple
int-1.wrong: I have worked at Vestel from 2019 to 2022.
int-1.right: I worked at Vestel from 2019 to 2022.

int-2.head: Short answers that match
int-2.wrong: Do you have a driving licence? - I like driving very much.
int-2.right: Do you have a driving licence? - Yes, I do. Since 2015.

int-3.head: -ed or -ing
int-3.wrong: I am very interesting in this role.
int-3.right: I am very interested in this role.

int-4.head: -ing after a preposition
int-4.wrong: I'm good at to explain numbers.

int-5.head: past continuous and past simple
int-5.wrong: I worked on the night shift when the system crashed.
int-5.right: I was working on the night shift when the system crashed.

int-6.head: Problems right now
int-6.wrong: Sorry, your sound doesn't work right now.
int-6.right: Sorry, your sound isn't working right now.

int-7.head: Asking good questions
int-7.wrong: What the next steps are after today?
int-7.right: What are the next steps after today?

int-8.head: would and if
int-8.wrong: If I would join your team, I will read the reports first.
int-8.right: If I joined your team, I would read the reports first.

int-9.head: Asking politely
int-9.wrong: I want to start next Monday instead.
int-9.right: Would it be possible to start next Monday instead?

mkt-1.head: used to
mkt-1.wrong: We were used to write long posts.
mkt-1.right: We used to write long posts.

mkt-2.head: Parts of a group
mkt-2.wrong: The most of our buyers are women.
mkt-2.right: Most of our buyers are women.

mkt-3.head: Rules in a brief
mkt-3.wrong: You don't have to use the word 'cheap'.

mkt-4.head: suggest and recommend
mkt-4.wrong: I suggest you to cut the first line.
mkt-4.right: I suggest cutting the first line.

mkt-6.head: Questions that start conversations
mkt-6.wrong: Who does remember the first towel they bought?
mkt-6.right: Who remembers the first towel they bought?

mkt-7.head: the passive
mkt-7.wrong: Our towels are make in Denizli.
mkt-7.right: Our towels are made in Denizli.

mkt-9.head: An exact apology
mkt-9.wrong: We are sorry for your towel arrived late.
mkt-9.right: We are sorry that your towel arrived late.

mkt-10.head: Results over time
mkt-10.right: Since March, reach has fallen by 10%.

mkt-11.head: past perfect
mkt-11.wrong: Before she found us, she tried three other brands.
mkt-11.right: Before she found us, she had tried three other brands.

mkt-12.head: Plans with conditions
mkt-12.wrong: If the post will get fewer than 50 likes, we change the hook.
mkt-12.right: If the post gets fewer than 50 likes, we will change the hook.

sales-1-1.head: which means
sales-1-1.wrong: It has a 48-hour battery, it means you charge it less.
sales-1-1.right: It has a 48-hour battery, which means you charge it less.

sales-1-2.head: Polite questions
sales-1-2.wrong: Could you tell me when is he back?
sales-1-2.right: Could you tell me when he is back?

sales-1-3.head: Talking about needs
sales-1-3.wrong: Do you want that we ship in two parts?
sales-1-3.right: Do you want us to ship in two parts?

sales-2-1.head: Questions that qualify
sales-2-1.wrong: From who do you buy now?
sales-2-1.right: Who do you buy from now?

sales-2-2.head: Comparing terms
sales-2-2.wrong: FOB is more cheap than CIF for the buyer.
sales-2-2.right: FOB is cheaper than CIF for the buyer.

sales-2-3.head: if and unless
sales-2-3.wrong: Unless you don't pay by Friday, the price changes.
sales-2-3.right: Unless you pay by Friday, the price changes.

sales-3-1.head: although, however, despite
sales-3-1.wrong: Despite our price is higher, you save on returns.
sales-3-1.right: Although our price is higher, you save on returns.

sales-3-2.head: Trading in a negotiation
sales-3-2.wrong: If you would sign today, we could ship in May.
sales-3-2.right: If you signed today, we could ship in May.

sales-3-3.head: Order confirmations
sales-3-3.wrong: Your order will be ship on Monday.
sales-3-3.right: Your order will be shipped on Monday.

sales-4-1.head: Passing on a complaint
sales-4-1.wrong: She asked me if can we replace the box.
sales-4-1.right: She asked me if we could replace the box.

sales-4-2.head: News and updates
sales-4-2.wrong: We have found the problem yesterday.
